title: ContextMirror Unified Data Contract
description: This is the shared contract between all MCP servers, the orchestrator, and the frontend. It defines the shape of the data for daily records, insights, and API responses.

HealthMetrics.description: A single day's health snapshot from the Health MCP server

heart_rate_avg.description: Average resting heart rate in bpm

active_minutes.description: Minutes of activity above resting threshold

CalendarEvent.description: A single calendar event from the Calendar MCP server

status.description: Whether the event was kept, cancelled, or is uncertain

attendee_count.description: Number of attendees including the user

MessageSummary.description: Daily messaging summary per contact/chat from the WhatsApp MCP server

chat_id.description: Unique identifier for the chat (e.g. WhatsApp JID)

contact_name.description: Display name of the contact or group

date.description: The day this summary covers, e.g. 2025-01-15

response_time_avg_seconds.description: Average time in seconds between receiving a message and responding

active_hours.description: List of hours (0-23) when messages were sent

sentiment_score.description: Sentiment of messages sent: -1 (negative) to 1 (positive). Optional, from ML engine.

DayRecord.description: The unified snapshot of a single day across ALL data sources. The orchestrator assembles this by calling all 3 MCP servers.

date.description: The day this record covers, e.g. 2025-01-15

health.description: Populated by the Health MCP server

calendar_events.description: Populated by the Calendar MCP server

messaging.description: Populated by the WhatsApp MCP server

PatternInsight.description: A single pattern or insight generated by the ML engine. This is what gets shown on the frontend as a 'Reflect Card'.

type.description: correlation: two things move together. trend: something is changing over time. anomaly: something unusual happened. cluster: days that feel similar.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the pattern, e.g. 'On nights with < 6h sleep, you send 40% fewer messages the next morning'

confidence.description: How statistically confident the ML engine is (0-1)

sources.description: Which data sources contributed to this insight

date_range.description: The time window this pattern was detected in

supporting_data.description: Raw numbers the frontend can use for charts. Shape is flexible depending on insight type.

reflection_question.description: A neutral, open-ended question to show the user, e.g. 'What usually happens on your low-sleep nights?'

InsightResponse.description: The full response the orchestrator sends to the frontend. This is the top-level API response shape.

summary.description: A 2-3 sentence narrative summary generated by the fine-tuned LLM

timeline.description: The raw day-by-day data, used by the frontend timeline view
